# Babaji Ashram Poland

> Spiritual retreat center in the Kłodzko Valley (Poland), following the teachings of Sri Haidakhan Babaji — Truth, Simplicity, Love.

Key facts:
- **Name**: Ashram Babaji (Ashram Haidakhan Babaji) · **Founded**: 1990
- **URL**: https://babaji.org.pl (Polish, default) · https://babaji.org.pl/en/ (English)
- **Location**: Mąkolno 129, 57-250 Mąkolno, Dolnośląskie, Poland — coordinates 50.5297, 16.9567
- **Contact**: +48 536 555 899 (general) · +48 570 016 826 (accommodation/events) · babaji.poland@gmail.com
- **Practices**: Karma Yoga ("Work is Worship"), Nama Japa (Om Namah Shivay), Havan (fire ceremony), Aarti (light ceremony), meditation, Kriya Yoga
- **Schedule**: weekly Havan; annual festivals (Navaratri, Shivaratri, Guru Purnima, Janmashtami, Diwali, Holi, Makar Sankranti, Chaitra Navaratri, Ram Navami, Ganesh Chaturthi, Dussehra, Vasant Panchami); spring and summer retreats
- **Visiting**: advance contact required; guest rooms; student discounts; the ashram is a place of silence and focus
- **Donations**: bank transfer (IBAN PL90 1240 6726 1111 0000 5636 8550, SWIFT PKOPPLPW) — details on the donations page
